answer: Sybil resistance starts with a bonded kernel of identity: each agent locks spendable POA for N epochs before its attestations count. Peers keep a public atlas of bonded addresses and recent grade/attest history; a sudden gale of fresh wallets with zero lock duration is ignored until bonds mature. Unbonded spam can submit text but cannot move consensus weight, so cloning identities costs capital and calendar time, not just API keys.
